# SQL Patterns: sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split

## Common WHERE Filters

### 获取最新有效分区

所有查询使用 `max(grass_date)` 模式确定最新有效分区：

```sql
-- 标准模式: 获取不晚于目标日期的最新分区
select max(grass_date) as grass_date
from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split
where date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') >= grass_date
```

### 固定日期过滤

手动任务中常用固定日期：

```sql
WHERE grass_date = DATE '2026-06-01'
WHERE grass_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
```

### exp_group 过滤

```sql
WHERE exp_group IN ('Smart ABT Group')              -- treatment group
WHERE exp_group IN ('Global Control', 'Local Sandbox')  -- control groups
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### 自连接获取最新分区

通过 `max(grass_date)` CTE 自连接获取最新有效分区的数据：

```sql
with sg_valid_date_11 as (
    select max(grass_date) as grass_date
    from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split
    where date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') >= grass_date
),
sg_data_11 as (
    select
        date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') as grass_date,
        'SG' as grass_region,
        case when exp_group in ('Smart ABT Group') then 'mp_plus_ads'
             when exp_group in ('Global Control', 'Local Sandbox') then 'control'
        end as group_name,
        a.user_id
    from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split a
    join sg_valid_date_11 b on a.grass_date = b.grass_date
)
```

## Common Aggregations

### 用户数统计 (GROUP BY)

```sql
select
    grass_date,
    'SG' as grass_region,
    case when exp_group in ('Smart ABT Group') then 'mp_plus_ads'
         when exp_group in ('Global Control', 'Local Sandbox') then 'control'
    end as group_name,
    count(distinct(user_id)) as user_cnt
from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split
where grass_date >= date('2026-04-01')
group by 1, 2, 3
```

### 按 exp_group 维度汇总

```sql
select
    grass_date,
    'SG' as grass_region,
    exp_group,
    count(distinct(user_id)) as user_cnt
from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split_25sss
where grass_date >= date('2026-04-01')
group by 1, 2, 3
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. 标准 Smart Voucher 用户黑名单分组 (workflow)

```sql
with sg_valid_date_11 as (
    select max(grass_date) as grass_date
    from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split
    where date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') >= grass_date
),
sg_data_11 as (
    select * from (
        select
            date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') as grass_date,
            'SG' as grass_region,
            case when exp_group in ('Smart ABT Group') then 'mp_plus_ads'
                 when exp_group in ('Global Control', 'Local Sandbox') then 'control'
            end as group_name,
            a.user_id
        from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split a
        join sg_valid_date_11 b on a.grass_date = b.grass_date
    )
    where day(grass_date) not in (25)
    union
    select * from (
        select
            date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') as grass_date,
            'SG' as grass_region,
            case when exp_group in ('Smart ABT Group') then 'mp_plus_ads'
                 when exp_group in ('Global Control', 'Local Sandbox') then 'control'
            end as group_name,
            a.user_id
        from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split_25sss a
        join sg_valid_date_11 b on a.grass_date = b.grass_date
    )
    where day(grass_date) in (25)
)
```

## 姊妹表说明

存在一个姊妹表 `sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split_25sss`，用于每月 25 号的数据补丁。使用模式：

```sql
-- 非 25 号: 用主表
from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split ... where day(grass_date) not in (25)

-- 25 号: 用 25sss 表
from sgbi_general.smart_abt_user_split_25sss ... where day(grass_date) in (25)
```
